history.summary: Compact 99-yr 4BR (1,227sqft) at $2,363 PSF, 410m from One-North MRT in D5, almost certainly One-North Eden (TOP ~2024-26). Premium location at the heart of the One-North tech/biomedical cluster with deep professional-tenant demand, but a 1,227sqft '4BR' is a tightly-stacked layout and the $2.9M quantum is steep for 99-yr leasehold.
history.rating_rationale: Location is genuinely top-tier — 410m to One-North MRT, inside the One-North/Fusionopolis/Biopolis employment belt, 1km to Fairfield Methodist — which underwrites strong rental demand (the 'highest yield in D5' pitch is plausible). But 1,227sqft for a 4BR is a squeezed mass-market layout, $2,363 PSF is full new-launch RCR pricing on a 99-yr lease, and $2.9M is above the deepest-liquidity band. No URA series to verify the trend. Strong fundamentals offset by stretched price/lease and a compact floorplate.
